title: A 60-Ton Space Rock Is Still Lying Where It Landed

scenes.text: A sixty-ton chunk of space metal is still lying where it fell.
It is the Hoba meteorite in Namibia, the biggest meteorite ever found.
It is about nine feet across, and it is mostly solid iron.
A farmer's plough hit it in 1920.
It is so heavy that nobody ever moved it, so it stays right where it landed.
A rock from space too heavy for Earth to move.

description:
The Hoba meteorite in Namibia weighs about sixty tons and is the largest meteorite ever found.
A farmer hit it with his plough in 1920, and it has never been moved because it is so heavy.
Would you travel to see it?
first_comment: It is about 82 percent iron. How big a meteorite do you think hit the Earth to leave a crater?
